# SMM Agent

AI social media automation for operators, agencies, and lean teams: draft, approve, and publish social posts with source-backed evidence and bring-your-own model keys.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://smmagent.app/)
- [Blog](https://smmagent.app/blog)

## What this product does
- Drafts social posts from source material with citations
- Human-in-the-loop approval before publishing
- Works with X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and other platforms
- Bring-your-own model keys (OpenAI-compatible)
- Source-backed content: no ungrounded AI posts

## Key facts
- Operated by Max Petrusenko
- Domain: smmagent.app (clawposter.app and smmclaw.app are retired and redirect here)
- Blog articles cover evaluation, evidence, and drafting workflows
